lines.say: {f1}Same reaction, two flasks. {f2}The right one has double the concentration. {q}On the left, the half-life is sixteen minutes. On the right?
Real OCR A-level question. {pz}Pause and try it!
{tl}Let's time-lapse it. {go}It's first order, so the rate depends on concentration. {fast}The right flask reacts twice as fast.
{m16}But at sixteen minutes, {h1}the left has halved. {h2}And so has the right! Twice the rate, but twice as much to get through.
{m32}Thirty-two minutes: halved again. Both. {graph}Plot them, {shift}and it's the same curve, just shifted along.
{ans}So the half-life is still sixteen minutes! {rule}For first order, it doesn't depend on concentration.
{trap}If you said eight, you only thought about the faster rate.
{o}Try this question and more at TrainTanmay. Link in bio!
